### Top forum threads [...] Hi Product Hunt, I'm Emad, one of the makers of Octri. 👋  
  
If you ship an API you know the routine: write the docs by hand, bolt on an SDK generator, then have no idea when those SDKs break inside someone's production app. Octri does the whole thing from one OpenAPI spec: a docs site, SDKs in ten languages (TypeScript, Python, Go, Rust, Ruby, PHP, Java, Kotlin, Swift, Dart) and an MCP server so Claude or Cursor can call your API.  
  
What is new though? Let me tell you! The SDKs monitor themselves. A failed call in a user's app comes back as a de-minified stack trace tagged to the exact release. No separate error-tracking setup! more about how it works and its security here: [...] GitHub sync regenerates and republishes everything on every merge. Free tier is available to try it out and keep it if your API doesn't need more than the offered limits + we offer an OSS program as well for the open-source community! more about it here:   
  
Point it at your own spec and try it out free! All comments and feedback are welcome. We'll be here answering every one of them!
